label: refusalIsSuccess: Photo's key faces drop the workspace's help, so a disabled Brush's B picks it
firstCharacterOnly: Photo reads the first of several typed characters, so "bv" picks Brush
find: guard characters.count == 1, let key = characters.first else { return nil }
replace: guard let key = characters.first else { return nil }

label: localLookup: Design matches the letter itself, case-sensitive and blind to a disabled tool, so P picks Pen
firstCharacterOnly: Design reads the first of several typed characters, so "rv" picks Rectangle
find: guard characters.count == 1, let key = characters.first else { return nil }
replace: guard let key = characters.first else { return nil }

label: caseSensitive: ToolKeys stops lower-casing the key, so a Shift-typed R picks nothing in Design or Photo
noStep: Shift on a shared letter stays on the current tool, so Shift-J never reaches Heal or Remove
cycleIgnoresHelp: the Shift cycle counts disabled tools, so Shift-J lands on a tool that can't act
find: let group = faces.filter { picking.tool(forKey: key, in: [$0]) != nil }.map(\.id)
